positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, built, and shipped Sparr, a SwiftUI iOS guitar training app featuring a custom AVAudioEngine and AVAudioSequencer MIDI engine with real-time tempo stretching, pitch transposition, and looping

• Maintain DLParser (Swift, Kotlin), an open-source parsing library for AAMVA-compliant driver's licenses and state IDs, updating models and maintaining parity across modern iOS and Android toolchains
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Mobile Applications · Software Infrastructure · Unity

positions.title: Platform Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Audited and resolved analytics tracking discrepancies across 5 modular iOS features for a Fortune 500 client by correcting lifecycle bindings and resolving UIKit/SwiftUI state mismatches in a hybrid codebase

• Expanded test automation across six Swift feature modules by writing XCUITest suites using the Robot pattern and unit tests for Redux state, while extending automated accessibility checks to cover dark mode execution paths

• Evaluated cross-plugin event messaging and platform UI limitations, producing architectural trade-off documentation for stakeholder alignment and future engineering implementation

• Built and shipped a production CMS-driven web application for a startup client in three weeks, leveraging Astro, React, Contentful, and Cloudflare while using custom Claude Code agent workflows to meet a tight deadline
positions.insights: Skills: Mobile Applications · Front-End Development · Software Infrastructure · Test Automation · Claude Code

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the mobile API migration from REST to GraphQL alongside an Android engineer by building a proxy layer over abstracted repositories, using domain-based feature flags and slow rollouts to transition API traffic safely

• Migrated mobile CI pipelines from CircleCI to GitHub Actions, introducing PR-triggered build checks to reduce CI spending and manual dispatch triggers for deployments, automated release notes, and version tagging

• Engineered core iOS user flows including onboarding, account deletion, and post-booking feedback prompts that generated thousands of positive App Store ratings, while resolving complex multi-timezone booking bugs to restore scheduling accuracy

• Facilitated Scrum ceremonies, mentored a web engineer transitioning to iOS using VIPER architecture, reviewed Android PRs, and contributed PHP and TypeScript backend updates to maintain sprint momentum

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Engineered a configurable Kafka data connector using YAML and internal platform abstractions to automate batch data ingestion into the analytics platform

• Developed custom Angular web interfaces, including a visual ETL pipeline rule-builder (CSV parsing, regex matching) and an interactive likelihood-distribution histogram widget for asset risk analysis

• Consulted ops teams and incoming developers on previously authored mobile applications while maintaining core Python data abstraction layers and Docker deployments
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · React.js · Angular · Containerization · Mobile Applications

positions.title: Android Engineer
positions.description:
• Assumed the Android technical lead role for a team of 3 engineers, conducting code reviews, stand ups, and 1:1s while driving an incremental refactor from legacy Java to Kotlin and MVVM

• Partnered directly with a design agency and stakeholders to execute a piece-wise app redesign, negotiating technical trade-offs to deliver continuous, timely feature slices without operational disruption
positions.insights: Skills: Android · Java · Kotlin · Team Leadership

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and published the first iOS and Android Haystax apps used by hundreds of first responders across the nation, integrating biometric auth, map clustering, license scanning, and a seamless offline experience

• Maintained legacy Objective-C iOS apps while developing features across the Python backend and Angular web interface to ensure cross-platform feature parity
positions.insights: Skills: iOS · Android · Mobile Applications · Java · Swift (Programming Language)
